NavierStokesR3.theorem_1_1 (R3/Theorem.lean:46) is unconditional and states Theorem 1.1 clause for clause: ∀ ν > 0, one u, p, f, K with smoothness on [0,1) × R³, f the zero extension of a C_c^∞(R³ × (0,∞)) field, one compact K containing both spatial supports on [0,1), (1.1) with ν multiplying only Δu, zero initial velocity, a uniform kinetic-energy bound on [0,1), unbounded speed as t ↑ 1, and no global smooth finite-energy competitor for the same force and datum. The only gaps are encodings: pointwise sup for the L∞ norm, and (1.1) imposed on (0,1) instead of [0,1). Both recover in a few lines from clauses present in the same structure, so the verdict is OK with relation different_formulation.

findings.summary: The blow-up clause is rendered pointwise (SpeedUnboundedAtOne: some point x with |u(t,x)| > M at times arbitrarily close to 1) rather than as limsup of the L∞ norm; the two agree because the slices are continuous.
The PDE (1.1) is imposed only on the open time interval Ioo 0 1, while the paper states it on R³ × [0,1); divergence-freeness and the initial condition are imposed on the closed-at-0 interval.
